about_the_game:
TRY ON THE SKIN OF A WEREWOLF

In Wolf With Inn, your friends aren’t noble white knights wielding massive swords, but monsters, mermaids, mushroom folk, and others who often become targets for glory hunters—after all, you’re a werewolf. All of this unfolds in a cozy tavern simulator set in a world of dark fairy tales.

GROW YOUR BUSINESS

Wake up and set out to explore Mystmoor, complete story-driven quests, and gather ingredients for your dishes. In the evening, run your tavern—cook, unlock new recipes, handle especially rowdy patrons, and repair the tavern after their antics—and deal with the consequences of your own actions.

BECOME THE MASTER OF A DARK FOREST

In the dense thickets of Mystmoor, you will find more than just ingredients for your dishes. Befriend mushroom folk while chopping wood, take down the “good guys,” rescue monsters, and build a thousand bridges between those who have forgotten how to speak to one another. They’ll definitely call you a bridge builder. Right?

EXPLORE A COZY WORLD

Catch fish, chop wood, and grind grain—all through various mini-games. Wolf With Inn is full of activities that turn routine tasks into a meditative experience. After all, isn’t that why we love cozy games?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 или AMD Phenom II X4
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 6570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K или AMD FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R9 270
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows Compatible Audio Device

short_description: You are a werewolf with your own inn. Mushroom folk live across the river, and noble white knights want you dead. Wolf With Inn is a cozy fantasy tavern simulator for those tired of being the hero. Dare to don the wolf's skin?
